hero_kpi_rationale: The $2.5 billion goodwill reflects Sonoco's portfolio transformation strategy, including the major acquisition of Eviosys in December 2024 for $3.8 billion, which expanded global presence in metal packaging.

risks.title: Goodwill Impairment Risk
risks.score_rationale: The goodwill associated with the Metal Packaging EMEA ($1,397 million) and Global Paper Products APAC ($26.9 million) reporting units is at risk of impairment if operations do not meet management expectations. Sensitivity analyses indicate that discount rates for Metal Packaging EMEA could increase up to 12.7% or projected EBITDA could decline by 3.0% before impairment.

risks.title: Income Tax Uncertainty
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to income tax uncertainties and follows ASC 740. The company's tax estimates are based on judgments and assumptions that could be challenged by tax authorities.

risks.title: Pension and Postretirement Benefits Liabilities
risks.score_rationale: The company has significant liabilities related to pension and postretirement benefit plans ($177,976 thousand as of December 31, 2025), which could have a significant impact on financial results. Estimates are based on demographic and actuarial assumptions.

risks.title: Foreign Exchange Fluctuations
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in 37 countries and is exposed to fluctuations in foreign exchange rates. With the acquisition of Eviosys, exposure to European currencies has increased significantly.

risks.title: Share-Based Compensation Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company uses share-based compensation plans for talent attraction and retention. Estimates for compensation plans are based on stock price volatility assumptions and employee turnover assumptions.

risks.title: Cybersecurity Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company operates across 265 sites in 37 countries and is exposed to cybersecurity risks. A cyberattack or data loss could disrupt critical operations and have a significant financial impact.

ai_positioning.summary: Sonoco has not mentioned artificial intelligence (AI) or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F filing. The information provided focuses on the company's financial operations, acquisitions, and divestitures, with no reference to AI or related technology.
